original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚一专科医院一年内完成50例机器人手术
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚拉各斯Kelina医院宣布，一年内完成超过50例机器人辅助根治性前列腺切除术，为前列腺癌患者提供创伤更小、功能恢复更好的治疗选择。院方称自6月起每周开展机器人前列腺手术，且未给任何患者输血。该院还称2025年完成尼日利亚首例机器人根治性肾切除术。

key_facts.fact: Kelina医院一年内完成超过50例机器人辅助根治性前列腺切除术
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Kelina Hospital has performed over 50 robotic radical prostatectomy surgeries in one year

key_facts.fact: 院方称自6月起每周开展机器人前列腺手术且未给患者输血
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the hospital has been performing robotic prostate surgery weekly since June, and has never given any patient blood transfusion since then

key_facts.fact: 院方称2025年完成尼日利亚首例机器人根治性肾切除术
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the hospital successfully performed the first Robotic Radical Nephrectomy in Nigeria in 2025

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚每年估计新诊断24396例前列腺癌病例
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: 24,396 new prostate cancer cases are diagnosed annually in Nigeria
